column1: # Gold standard for stress and homographs, checked by tests/test_curation.py.
# Every (form, stress_idx) below must appear in out/parole-accenti-frequenze.csv.
#   form        NFC lowercase spelling, as in the output (città, perché, capitano)
#   stress_idx  character index of the stressed vowel in `form`
#   default     1 = must be the default reading, 0 = must be non-default,
#   note        the stress-marked form first, then an optional gloss after a space
# The output has one row per (form, stress): readings that differ only in vowel
# quality (pèsca/pésca) are one row, so such a pair is one gold row.
# Standard Italian stress as given by DOP / Treccani. Add rows by hand; compute
# stress_idx from the marked form with text.resolve_spelling rather than counting.
